page.content:
Marvel's first family of heroes.

How Fantastic Four connects

  • Character: Reed Richards — Reed Richards leads the Fantastic Four.
  • Character: Sue Storm — Sue Storm is a founding Fantastic Four member.
  • Character: Human Torch — Johnny Storm is the Fantastic Four's Human Torch.
  • Character: The Thing — Ben Grimm is the Thing of the Fantastic Four.
  • Topic: Marvel — The Fantastic Four launched modern Marvel.
  • Location: New York City — The Fantastic Four are based in New York City.
  • Work: Fantastic Four (2005 film) — The 2005 film adapts the Fantastic Four.

What is Fantastic Four?

The Fantastic Four—Reed, Sue, Johnny, and Ben—launch modern Marvel with cosmic powers and ties to New York City, the Silver Surfer, and cosmic threats.

Key threads lead to Reed Richards, Sue Storm, Human Torch, The Thing, Marvel and New York City.
